jobs.title: Part-Time LSAT Tutor
jobs.description: About Inspira Education Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities. As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide. As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub). The Role We are looking for Law School Admission Test (LSAT) Tutors who are passionate about education and driven to help students succeed. If you love mentoring, test prep, and empowering others, this is the role for you! You’ll work one-on-one with students, create personalized study plans, and provide expert guidance to help them excel on every section of the LSAT. This part-time role requires a commitment of approximately 20 hours per week , including tutoring and preparation time. Tutoring sessions are scheduled around student availability and may include weekday afternoons, evenings, and weekends. This is a remote role that can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada. jobs.description: Punya pengalaman mengajar dan suka berinteraksi dengan dunia anak sekolah? Mari bergabung bersama kami sebagai Tutor / Pengajar Akademik ! Kami mencari pengajar full-time yang ramah, asyik, dan sabar dalam membimbing siswa. Yuk, salurkan hobi mengajarmu dan jadilah bagian dari tim pendidik kami yang solid! Kami Mencari Tutor/Pengajar Bimbel: Kimia (Prioritas) , Fisika, Matematika, Bahasa Indonesia, Bahasa Inggris, Soshum (Geografi, Sosiologi, Ekonomi), Tutor/Pengajar UTBK (kelas 12) Deskripsi Pekerjaan: Merencanakan dan menyampaikan materi pembelajaran dengan metode yang menarik, interaktif, dan mudah dipahami oleh siswa. Membangun suasana kelas yang positif, aktif, dan memotivasi siswa untuk semangat belajar. Kualifikasi: Pendidikan minimal S1, diutamakan lulusan Perguruan Tinggi Negeri (PTN). Memiliki pengalaman mengajar di lembaga bimbingan belajar/Bimbel (Diutamakan). Mampu mengajar secara luring (offline) maupun daring (online). Memiliki passion yang tinggi di dunia pendidikan, komunikatif, ramah, dan peduli pada perkembangan siswa. Bersedia bekerja penuh waktu (Full-time) dari kantor (WFO). Bersedia bekerja dengan jam operasional pukul 10:00 hingga 19:00 WIB. Diutamakan berdomisili dan bersedia ditempatkan di wilayah Tangerang Raya (Kota & Kabupaten) Benefit / Tunjangan: Gaji bulanan. Fasilitas BPJS. THR Cuti Tahunan & Melahirkan Lamaran dan CV juga bisa dikirimkan ke: email: bimbelstrategis@gmail.com WA: 0878 7179 6349 (Pak Kamal)

jobs.title: AI Trainer - Video Annotation
jobs.description: AI Trainer - Video Annotation Remote | Independent Contractor Prove your skills. Get certified. Robotics AI is advancing rapidly, and high-quality video data helps intelligent systems better understand the world around them. We are inviting detail-oriented professionals to complete our certification process for potential robotics AI projects. ▌ What you will do As part of the certification process, you will demonstrate your ability to: Annotate short video clips by identifying objects, actions and events. Evaluate video quality, relevance and accuracy against established guidelines. Assess the clarity and plausibility of movements. Apply instructions consistently and identify potential quality issues. ▌ What you bring Strong attention to detail and analytical thinking. Strong written English and the ability to follow detailed instructions independently. A commitment to accuracy and consistency. No previous AI or robotics experience required. ▌ What the work looks like You may review short videos and be asked to tag objects or actions, rate video clarity or camera angles on a 1 to 10 scale, or assess whether movements are clearly visible and plausible. Please note: We currently have three projects open, and completing the certification process will allow us to evaluate which project may be the best fit for you.
